page_title: RAY 1-1 CAD | Rayo Vallecano v Cadiz CF 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+18' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+12' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90+12' 1 - 1 Goal! Victor Chust plays a pass to the feet of Javi Hernandez (Cadiz), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 1:1.
90+11' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is adjudged offside.
90+8' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+7' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Isi Palazon is replaced by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
90+4' Today's match ends for Robert Navarro who will be replaced by Darwin Machis (Cadiz).
90+4' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas had an easy-decision to make.
89' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
88' Goal! Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
88' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
86' Here comes a substitution. Rominigue Kouame is given a rest as he is replaced by Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz).
85' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to make a change. Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) replaces Ruben Sobrino.

83' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul.
81' Here comes a substitution. Chris Ramos (Cadiz) is brought on as a substitute for Juanmi.
81' Substitution. Maximiliano Gomez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
81' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Oscar Valentin.
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Raul de Tomas.
77' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Rough tackle by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
72' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
61' The game is interrupted.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
56' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Miguel Crespo and he is replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Oscar Trejo can be given a rest.
54' Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).

53' He should have scored! Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Conan Ledesma makes an easy save.
51' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
47' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
43' Javier Alberola Rojas shows a yellow card to Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
40' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
34' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Javier Alberola Rojas signals.
30' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

30' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cadiz CF.
30' Good work from Cadiz CF as they win a corner.
29' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
24' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
23' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle. Robert Navarro (Cadiz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
21' None of the Cadiz CF players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
20' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' Cadiz CF win a corner.
19' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
14' Dangerous play by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz). Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.

10' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
7' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
5' Rayo Vallecano quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
4' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The match has just started.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Javier Alberola Rojas was nominated as the referee for this game.
